description: START HERE for any 'what do you have on X / what did the search find' question — ONE plain-language briefing of a run, in the client-voiced wording (which search product this run was, overall risk in plain words, each conflict in 1–2 plain sentences, any conditions on the result). Facts, never advice. No internal stage names, no risk-formula codes, no model names. Reach for the audit tools (get_run, trace, decision_timeline, get_telemetry) only when the user asks HOW the system reached a conclusion.
